rules: Each large batch is subdivided at actual artifact prerequisites; complete a coherent mechanism before proceeding.
Existing accepted identities, objectives, unit contracts, hour records and receipts stay unchanged.
Inspect actual source passages before teaching authorship; unavailable sources remain gaps.
Register new taxonomy leaves only with evidence of a missing competency and an assessable artifact; do not force an old three-objective quota on additions.
Inspect the accessible corpus beyond existing taxonomy and census; a bibliography or index is only a discovery aid.

T70 small-buffer artifact precedes T69.05. T65's cost review records direct operation/storage counts until T66's counting allocator exists; later integration reruns allocation comparisons without claiming the early run consumed a nonexistent artifact.
Independent review requires a recorded non-author identity and scope. Learner mastery, physical observations and learning effectiveness require their own actual evidence.
